title: Severn Estuary Tidal Barrage
summary: A 16 km barrage across the Bristol Channel, capable of supplying roughly 5% of UK electricity, was seriously studied and costed (£15 billion in 1989 terms) by a government-backed consortium but shelved on environmental and economic grounds. The Blair government commissioned a further feasibility review in 2008–2010, which again concluded the project was not viable. No construction has begun despite the site holding one of the world's highest tidal ranges.
